text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated 5xx rate (502/504) for service="edge-proxy" in region=euc2 AZ=azd. 5xx 18% over baseline. Paging emily (oncall).

emily (oncall): ack — I'm on it. Which customer-facing routes?

sarah (sre): seeing spikes across /v1/generate and websocket proxied routes. ELB (classic/ALB) targetgroup: ~45% unhealthy in azd, cross-az latency up. Route53 health checks for edge-proxies are flapping.

emily (oncall): pulled recent logs, SNI handshake failures and TCP RSTs from some ENI IPs in azd. Example in auth-proxy logs: 
```
[2026-03-15T02:11:02Z] upstream ssl handshake failed: unexpected EOF while reading
[2026-03-15T02:11:03Z] connection reset by peer (peer_ip=10.12.45.132)
```

raj (neteng): running quick neighbor check on affected hosts — seeing repeated ARP updates, multiple MACs for same IPs. suspecting asymmetric routing / ARP table churn on azd subnet. run: `ip neigh show dev eth0 | grep STALE` — you'll see a lot.

matt (eng-runtime): I can roll a config to reduce long-lived keepalives on proxies (might reduce stuck connections). proposing canary 10% then 50%.

emily (oncall): immediate mitigation — shift Route53 weights away from euc2:azd to eu-west-1. Sarah, can you perform weight shift? We need minimal blast radius.

sarah (sre): doing weight shift now. Command: 
```
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z12345 --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"edge.example.com","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"eu-west-1","Weight":80,"TTL":60,"ResourceRecords":[{"Value":"34.12.23.45"}]}}]}'
```
Shifting to eu-west-1 80% / euc2 20% -> monitoring. :eyes:

lisa (support): prepping customer comms template. Notifying top 10 customers who hit 5xx over the last 30m. Draft in #customer-updates — please review.

raj (neteng): quick note — EC2 metadata/instance API rate error spikes observed while we correlate. Also saw EBS detach latency increase on some control-plane calls (timeouts 30s->120s). Opening AWS support case.

incident-bot: AWS Support Case opened: case-id 1234567890 by raj. Severity requested: urgent.

aws-support-bot: AWS support acknowledged, saying they are investigating control plane anomalies in euc2 AZ azd affecting ARP/neighbor propagation and ENI stability. No ETA yet.

matt (eng-runtime): I pushed a 10% canary disabling proxy keepalive (rollout id: rollout-20260315-01). If health improves we can expand.

sarah (sre): after weight shift + canary, 5xx dropped to ~6% and targetgroup healthy count increased by ~22% in 5m. Still seeing occasional RSTs from subset of hosts. Continue monitoring for 30m.

emily (oncall): good. document mitigation steps in the incident doc (incidents/SEV-1234). Declare incident Sev2 until full recovery.

lisa (support): sent proactives to customers in EU region, included guidance: temporary routing change, expected reduced latency to eu-west-1.

raj (neteng): AWS replied — internal network control plane saturation in azd causing ARP churn; they recommend instance reboots for badly behaved hosts as a short-term fix. Planning coordinated reboots for the small set of instances with repeated ENI flaps.

emily (oncall): agree to targeted reboots for 6 instances across autoscaling group edge-proxy-euc2-azd. Schedule one-by-one with health checks in between. Sarah, coordinate with deployment windows.

sarah (sre): will drain targets from TG, then reboot instance via SSM, wait for healthy, then proceed to next. Playbook snippet: 
```
# drain target
aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:... --targets Id=i-01234567
# reboot via SSM
aws ssm send-command --instance-ids i-01234567 --document-name AWS-RunShellScript --parameters commands=['sudo reboot']
# wait and re-register
```

matt (eng-runtime): adding circuit-breaker to route to fallback model variant to reduce downstream load during noisy failures. Rolling low-risk change.

incident-bot: Pager: escalation pending in 12m if error rate >10%.

nina (oncall): taking over active handoff from emily at 03:15 UTC. Hand-off notes: weight shift executed, canary keepalive=off @10%, AWS case 1234567890 open, targeted reboots planned for 6 instances, customer comms sent.

emily (oncall): handed off. Key risk: control plane flaps may return after reboots; prep to restore full weights slowly when targetgroups are stable.

aws-support-bot: update from AWS: they completed internal mitigation in azd and will monitor. They recommend keeping weights reduced for 15-30 minutes and avoid mass reboots unless instances still show ENI detach errors.

sarah (sre): incrementally returning weights to euc2:azd -> doing 30% -> 50% -> 70% checks with 5min stabilization windows. Observed stable at 50% for 15m, 5xx ~1.8% now.

nina (oncall): downtime window closed; moving to post-incident review. Assigning follow-ups: (1) neteng to dig hardware/kernel cause (raj), (2) runtime to add fallback routing policy automation (matt), (3) runbook update with ARP-churn troubleshooting (sarah).

lisa (support): will update customers with final summary once postmortem ready.

incident-bot: Incident resolved -> status: mitigated. Closing page. Add postmortem tag: azd-arp-churn-20260315. :white_check_mark:

emily (oncall): thanks team. Great coordination.
